He only appears in the Supreme Cup and faces the {{player}} in the Speed Course. ===[[Pokéathlon]]=== {{athletes|type=thlon|course=Speed|sprite=Ace Trainer m HGSS OD.png |{{athlete|ndex=085|pokemon=Dodrio|type1=Normal|type2=Flying|course=Speed}} |{{athlete|ndex=078|pokemon=Rapidash|type1=Fire|course=Speed}} |{{athlete|ndex=128|pokemon=Tauros|type1=Normal|course=Speed}} }} ===Sprites=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{thlon color dark}}; background: #{{thlon color}}; font-size:80%;" |- |style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{cuteness color dark}}; background: #{{cuteness color light}}; width:80px; height:80px;"| [[File:Ace Trainer m HGSS OD.png]] |- | Overworld sprite from
{{color2|000|Pokémon HeartGold and SoulSilver Versions|HeartGold and SoulSilver}} |} ==In the manga== ===Pokémon Adventures=== Jet appeared in ''[[PS442|Out-Odding Oddish]]'' as a Top Pokéathlete of the Pokéathlon, with the highest scores in every event and course. Jet is very popular, and has many fans that come rushing to see him compete. He faced {{adv|Gold}} in the Speed Course, and proved to be a very powerful opponent for him. After easily winning Pennant Capture and Hurdle Dash, Jet faced Gold in Relay Run, the last event of the Speed Course. Although it seemed like Jet would win, Gold managed to beat him with his [[Togebo]], giving Gold enough points to win the entire Speed Course, while Jet came in second. Afterward, Jet congratulated Gold for his performance. ===Pokémon=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Jet |pkmn=Voltorb |type1=Electric |img=Jet Voltorb Adventures.png |epnum=PS442 |epname=Out-Odding Oddish |desc=Jet registered {{p|Voltorb}} in the Speed Course. In Hurdle Dash, it managed to easily beat Gold's [[Sudobo]]. It was also used in Relay Run, where it got a huge lead in the race. None of Voltorb's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Jet |pkmn=Oddish |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Jet Oddish Adventures.png |epnum=PS442 |epname=Out-Odding Oddish |desc=Jet registered {{p|Oddish}} in the Speed Course. In Pennant Capture, it easily beat Gold's {{p|Sunflora|Sunbo}} by stealing many flags with the leaves on its head. It was also used in the Relay Run event, where it replaced Jet's Voltorb and was later switched with Dodrio. None of Oddish's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Jet |pkmn=Dodrio |gender=female |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Jet Dodrio Adventures.png |epnum=PS442 |epname=Out-Odding Oddish |desc=Jet registered {{p|Dodrio}} in the Speed Course. During the Relay Run event, she replaced Jet's Oddish. As she raced, she kicked Gold's Togebo into the sand, blinding him in the process. Despite this disadvantage, Gold managed to command Togebo where to go, allowing him to beat Dodrio. None of Dodrio's moves are known.}} ===Pokémon competitions=== Jet has competed in the following {{cat|Pokémon competitions}}: * [[Pokéathlon]] - Speed Course; Runner-up (''[[PS442|Out-Odding Oddish]]'') ==Trivia== * Jet's physical appearance in Pokémon Adventures is likely [[List of references to popular culture in Pokémon|based on]] the character Jet Link, aka Cyborg 002, from {{wp|Cyborg 009}}.
